articles.title: GitHub Releases · ComfyUI: v0.8.1
articles.summary: ## What's Changed * Fix stable release workflow not pulling latest comfy kitchen. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11695 * Support gemma 12B with quant weights. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11696 * model_patcher: Remove confusing load stat by @rattus128 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11710 * Add device selection for LTXAVTextEncoderLoader by @kijai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11700 * Lower ltxv text encoder vram use. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11713 * Bump required comfy-kitchen version. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11714 * Increase ltxav mem estimation by a bit. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11715 * Add memory estimation function to ltxav text encoder. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/11716 * ops: Fix offloading with FP8MM performance by @rattus128 in htt
